label: 茶铺建筑壳
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG for the 2D/2.5D Chinese tea-village game 茶园物语.
Style: clean Chinese ink outline with pale hand-painted watercolor fills, harmonizing with the approved references. Simple large clear shapes, controlled sparse brush marks, thin charcoal/brown linework; avoid dense texture or paper grain. Restrained ivory #EEE5D5, sage #83957E, tea green #526C62, charcoal #5C6261, pale timber #967653, bamboo #C5A36F, occasional dusty coral #B76651.
For constructed objects use elevated parallel dimetric 2:1 ground axes, diagonal edges slope about ±26.565 degrees, verticals remain vertical, near and far edges stay parallel, no lens perspective. Soft even light, modest internal shading, no cast ground shadow.
Output actual RGBA transparency outside the subject. Full silhouette, visible generous transparent margin on ALL four sides; never crop. No background fill, checkerboard, paper sheet, black background, white background, vignette, glow, halo, text, calligraphy, numerals, UI, labels, borders, watermark. No extra props, people, scenery, repeated objects or decorative clutter. Avoid oversaturation, muddy gradients, noise, excessive fiber or woodgrain, photorealism, heavy black outline and strong reflections. Preserve clear edges at small gameplay sizes.
Primary request: completely EMPTY roofless riverside tea-shop architectural shell, one independent transparent PNG. Input1 defines EXACT footprint projection, camera, framing and pale wooden floor; Input2 supplies tea-house structural character only, never copy its furniture, people, water, boat, greenery, words or UI.
Keep the Input1 rectangular2:1 floor and elevated parallel camera with generous transparent padding, subject only75% canvas width/height. Change rear walls to warm ivory plaster panels framed by pale timber, one simple modest lattice window per wall. Two rear walls meet at rear center, simple vertical structural posts. Floor boards smooth restrained pale wash, not dense woodgrain. Thin timber platform rim and a few SHORT square support piers integral beneath floor, suggesting riverside construction. The whole floor empty, no furnishings or wall artwork. NO roof, front wall, foreground railing or foreground pillars. No stairs extending off the canvas.
Wide1920×1080 composition; complete platform front corner and all piers at least60px inside canvas. No water, shoreline, ground shadow, lantern, sign, leaves, plants, jars, tools, tables, seating, tea equipment or people. This is an empty staging shell for separately added assets, not a complete rendered tea shop scene.
